## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-*juan* literary collection by **Zūnshì** 遵式 (964–1032), titled after his principal monastic residence at the Tiānzhúsì 天竺寺 in Hángzhōu. Companion to the *Jīnyuán jí* ([KR6d0226](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0226)); together the two works constitute Zūnshì's principal collected literary writings, edited by the later monk Huìguān.

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed with [KR6d0226](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0226) in Zūnshì's productive period c. 996–1032, with editorial finalisation extending into the Sòng-Yuán period.
